title: Functional programming and array methods interview drills

items.question: In production javascript, how would you explain map, filter, reduce, and chaining to a junior engineer debugging a related bug?
items.answer: Start with the mechanism: what the engine does at map, filter, reduce, and chaining. Give a 5-line example, name one pitfall (validation, async ordering, or null), and one tradeoff versus the shortcut. Mention how you would prove the fix with a test or DevTools.
followUps: What breaks if you skip validation at the boundary?
How does this differ in C#?
items.sixtySeconds: map, filter, reduce, and chaining: mechanism + example + pitfall + comparison — avoid hand-waving.
